headline: Sensex slumps 700 points as market volatility jumps; SIP inflows hit record ₹32,490 crore in September

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex plummeted over 1,000 points from its intraday high due to sharp profit booking
The India VIX jumped 7%, indicating a significant rise in market volatility and investor anxiety
Heavy selling in IT, FMCG, and financial sectors dragged the benchmark indices lower
Global market sentiment was mixed as investors focused on easing oil prices and upcoming corporate earnings
whatHappening: Nifty 50 dropped below the 22,400 level during a volatile trading session
Mutual fund SIP contributions reached a historic record high of ₹32,490 crore for September 2026
Swaraj Engines shares skyrocketed 15% following the announcement of strong Q2 financial results
New India Assurance shares surged 14%, extending gains for the second consecutive session
summary: The Indian stock market witnessed a sharp correction today with the Sensex falling over 700 points and Nifty slipping below 22,400. Despite the broad-based sell-off led by IT and financial stocks, mutual fund SIP inflows hit a record high of ₹32,490 crore. Individual stocks like Swaraj Engines and New India Assurance bucked the trend with significant double-digit gains.
